provenance_context: Originally developed for D6; evaluated as Bub moved toward a swappable-model architecture. This provenance does not establish that model-specific tuning caused the result.

methodology.primary: human-primary blind review with AI-assisted rubric interpretation and rationale editing
methodology.human_aggregation: Average two samples within case/condition, then equally weight 12 cases.
methodology.judge_aggregation: Average available samples within judge/case/condition, then equally weight covered cases.
methodology.panel_consensus: Post-reveal descriptive summary: average available judges per candidate, then samples within case/condition, then 12 equally weighted cases. n counts candidates, not judgments.
methodology.missing_values: Not imputed or scored as zero; potentially nonrandom.

intervention_diagnostics.caveat: The frozen gate concerned unsupported-risk refusal, sanitization, redirection or strong warning. Human interpretation broadened to unsupported psychologizing that redirected the task or recast motives. These recorded flags are not a validated conventional refusal rate. Human and model flags remain separate; zero observations do not imply zero risk.

caveats: 12 selected cases are the meaningful units, not 96 independent experiments or 569 independent judgments.
All six human composite intervals include zero; no frozen materiality threshold or equivalence margin.
Model judges are correlated assessments of the same outputs; GLM-5.2 is a same-family diagnostic.
Composite differences are concentrated in some cases; sensitivity analyses are not grounds to discard cases.
AI assistance with rubric interpretation and rationale editing limits claims of fully unaided human evaluation.
Private prompts, cases, response texts and rationales are withheld; this release does not enable full independent reproduction.

decision.conclusion: Quintessence failed to demonstrate sufficient incremental value in this pilot.
decision.C: Plain-English translation did not materially rescue the principles; no demonstrated added value over B or D.
decision.D: Strong conventional scores with undesirable behavioral tendencies; not adopted wholesale.
